faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BGSBU Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Assistant post at Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech in CE or a related degree, or an M.E./M.Tech in a related field. A B.E./B.Tech with a valid GATE/NET score is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Assistant position at Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Junior Research Assistant position must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University located?
faq.answer: Baba Ghulam Shah Badshah University is located in Rajouri, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 185234.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Assistant position is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
